add-background-image-stamp-to-pdf.title: Add Background Image Stamp to PDF Pages
add-background-image-stamp-to-pdf.description: Shows how to place an image stamp behind the existing content of each PDF page by setting the Background property to true using Aspose.Pdf.

add-bold-outlined-text-stamp.title: Add Bold Outlined Text Stamp to PDF
add-bold-outlined-text-stamp.description: Shows how to create a text stamp with fill‑stroke rendering to produce bold outlined text on a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf.

add-bottom-left-text-stamp.title: Add Bottom‑Left Text Stamp to PDF
add-bottom-left-text-stamp.description: Shows how to place a text stamp at the bottom‑left corner of each PDF page with a 10‑point margin using Aspose.Pdf.

add-confidential-text-stamp-to-pdf.title: Add Confidential Text Stamp to PDF
add-confidential-text-stamp-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, creating a semi‑transparent TextStamp, centering it on each page, and saving the stamped document.

add-custom-sized-page-stamp.title: Add Custom-Sized Page Stamp to PDF
add-custom-sized-page-stamp.description: Demonstrates creating a PdfPageStamp from an existing page, setting custom width, height, and position, and applying it to another page in a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.

add-diagonal-image-watermark-to-pdf.title: Add Diagonal Image Watermark to PDF
add-diagonal-image-watermark-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to apply an image stamp rotated 90° as a diagonal watermark on every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-diagonal-text-stamp-watermark.title: Add Diagonal Text Stamp Watermark to PDF
add-diagonal-text-stamp-watermark.description: Demonstrates how to add a semi‑transparent, 45‑degree rotated text stamp as a diagonal watermark on every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-faint-overlay-stamp-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Faint Overlay Stamp to PDF Pages
add-faint-overlay-stamp-to-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to apply a semi‑transparent text stamp as a faint overlay on every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-faint-text-overlay-stamp-to-pdf-page.title: Add Faint Text Overlay Stamp To Pdf Pages

add-fixed-size-image-stamp-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Fixed Size Image Stamp To Pdf Pages

add-full-page-image-watermark-to-pdf.title: Add Full-Page Image Watermark to PDF

add-global-text-stamp-to-all-pdf-pages.title: Add Global Text Stamp to All PDF Pages
add-global-text-stamp-to-all-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to create a TextStamp and apply it to every page of a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf's AddStamp method.

add-image-stamp-alt-text-pdfa.title: Add Image Stamp with Alt Text for PDF/A‑1b
add-image-stamp-alt-text-pdfa.description: Demonstrates how to place an image stamp with alternative text on every page of a PDF and then convert the document to PDF/A‑1b compliance using Aspose.Pdf.

add-image-stamp-floatingbox-page-4.title: Add Image Stamp as Background Using FloatingBox on Page 4

add-image-stamp-from-memory-stream-to-pd.title: Add Image Stamp from Memory Stream to PDF
add-image-stamp-from-memory-stream-to-pd.description: Demonstrates how to load an image into a MemoryStream and apply it as an ImageStamp to every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-image-stamp-from-memory-stream.title: Add Image Stamp From Memory Stream

add-image-stamp-percentage-position.title: Add Image Stamp with Percentage‑Based Positioning
add-image-stamp-percentage-position.description: Demonstrates how to place an image stamp on each page of a PDF using offsets expressed as percentages of the page width and height.

add-image-stamp-preserve-acroform-fields.title: Add Image Stamp While Preserving AcroForm Fields
add-image-stamp-preserve-acroform-fields.description: Demonstrates how to apply an ImageStamp to every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf while keeping existing AcroForm fields intact.

add-image-stamp-preserve-bookmarks.title: Add Image Stamp While Preserving Bookmarks and Outline
add-image-stamp-preserve-bookmarks.description: Demonstrates how to load an existing PDF, apply a semi‑transparent image stamp to every page, and save the document while keeping its bookmarks and outline intact.

add-image-stamp-preserve-embedded-files.title: Add Image Stamp to PDF While Preserving Embedded Files
add-image-stamp-preserve-embedded-files.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, iterate through its pages, add an image stamp to each page, and save the document while keeping any embedded files intact.

add-image-stamp-preserve-javascript.title: Add Image Stamp to PDF While Preserving JavaScript Actions
add-image-stamp-preserve-javascript.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, creating an ImageStamp, applying it to every page, and saving the document while keeping any existing JavaScript actions intact.

add-image-stamp-preserve-page-labels.title: Add Image Stamp to PDF While Preserving Page Labels
add-image-stamp-preserve-page-labels.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, create an ImageStamp, apply it to every page, and save the document while keeping existing page labels unchanged.

add-image-stamp-preserve-xmp-metadata.title: Add Image Stamp While Preserving XMP Metadata
add-image-stamp-preserve-xmp-metadata.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, retrieve its XMP metadata, apply an image stamp to every page, restore the original metadata, and save the result.

add-image-stamp-to-encrypted-pdf.title: Add Image Stamp to Encrypted PDF

add-rotated-image-stamp-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, creating an ImageStamp from an image, rotating it 45 degrees, positioning it, adding it to a page, and saving the result.

add-rotated-text-stamp-to-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to load a PDF, create a TextStamp, rotate it 90°, apply it to every page, and save the modified document.
